name: Magic Wand
tagline: Mouse, HUD, scrolling and speech to text from three buttons on a wand.
summary: Turning the wand moves my Mac’s pointer or the Agentic Mouse HUD outline. A Puck.js at the tip reads the rotation and sends it over Bluetooth.
status: Earlier controls were tested on the wand; the latest gestures and tuning still need a physical check.
Held positioning clicks on release and resumes prior high sensitivity after 300 ms. Ethan confirmed the still-hand tolerance feels good.
Screen-edge reversal, held Middle selection and circular scrolling pass regression checks; their physical feel is still unconfirmed.
End-to-end latency, accuracy and battery life haven’t been measured.

parts: Puck.js v2.1: gyro, Bluetooth and an RGB light
hardware.wiring: Each button connects its pin to GND. The Puck’s internal pull-ups make a press read low.

buttons.name: Middle
gestures: Open the HUD on Switch App, then turn the wand to move the outline
Use the outlined card on release
Hold the card; on some wheel cards, tilt to turn the wheel
notes: The outline stops at the edges instead of wrapping.
Bottom goes back to the pointer.

buttons.name: Bottom
gestures: The pointer follows the wand, without clicking
Move at low sensitivity; release clicks, pauses 300 ms, then resumes high sensitivity
Drag; release drops, pauses 300 ms, then resumes prior high sensitivity
notes: The pointer stays still while a click is decided.
High sensitivity is released-button follow. Holding Bottom is low sensitivity, at one-third speed.
While following with no buttons held, circle clockwise to scroll down or anticlockwise to scroll up.
The first full loop still moves the pointer; cyan shows scrolling has started. Pause to return to pointing.
The pointer stays within the real screen edges, including separate monitors.

chords.name: Bottom + Middle
gestures: Scroll sideways and up or down at once, including diagonals
